app.title: Psyduck Motion Mirror
app.description: Mirror upper-body motion with your camera, or use a preset or the auto demo.
app.scopeNotice: This version tracks major upper-body motion only. It does not capture full-body motion, fast turns, fingers, or facial expressions.

errors.deviceBusy: The camera is unavailable or in use by another application
errors.insecureContext: Open this page over HTTPS or localhost to use the camera
errors.browserUnsupported: This browser does not support pose tracking
errors.modelLoadFailed: Pose model failed to load; presets remain available
errors.rigLoadFailed: Character model failed to load; please retry
errors.resourceTimeout: Resource loading timed out; please retry

hints.upperBodyInFrame: Keep both shoulders and wrists in frame
hints.faceCameraHold: Face the camera and hold briefly
hints.returnToFrame: Return to the frame and wait for tracking

privacy.cameraOnlyNoMic: Uses the camera only; microphone permission is not requested
privacy.localProcessingOnly: Frames and pose landmarks are processed on this device
privacy.noUploadNoRecord: Data is not uploaded and is not recorded by default
privacy.staticNetworkOnly: Network requests are limited to the page and static resources

app.title: 可达鸭动作跟随
app.description: 通过摄像头捕捉上半身动作驱动可达鸭，也可使用预设动作或自动演示。
app.scopeNotice: 首版仅支持上半身主要动作跟随，暂不支持全身动作、快速转身、手指与表情捕捉。
